description: Multi-step Azure infrastructure workflow DAG with governance discovery before Architecture

challenger.artifact_scope: comprehensive: architecture; cost-feasibility: cost-estimate. Independent parallel reviews; opt_in_matrix replaces only the architecture review, never the separate cost-estimate review.

preconditions.description: Both architecture and cost-estimate reviews are required in default and deep modes. Preserve the separate challenge-findings-cost-estimate.json cost-feasibility review when opt_in_matrix replaces the architecture pass. Human approval follows resolution of blocking findings.
preconditions.check: architecture review and challenge-findings-cost-estimate.json are APPROVED with no unresolved blocking findings

preconditions.description: All plan-level challenger passes returned APPROVED. 06-IaC CodeGen must not run plan-level adversarial review or self-edit 04-implementation-plan.md; any plan must_fix returns to step-4.
Anti-livelock: gate-3 may re-open when any step-4 finding has requires_step == 'step-2'. Control returns to 03-Architect via the step-4 → step-2 return_edge.
preconditions.check: no step-4 challenger finding has requires_step == 'step-2'

preconditions.description: L0→L1→L2→L3 attestation chain present in session decisions (`apex/decide`, key: governance_trace) before Bicep deployment, Terraform apply or azd provision. Validator: validate-governance-trace.mjs.
preconditions.check: decisions.governance_trace present at step-6 OR human-override decision recorded

return_edges.reason: Architect identifies requirement gaps — return for refinement
Design step surfaces architecture re-evaluation needs
IaC Planner finds architecture rework needed
Anti-livelock: step-4 comprehensive finding requires architecture-level resolution (requires_step == 'step-2'). Closes the gate-3 all-passes-APPROVED livelock.
IaC Planner needs fresh governance discovery
IaC CodeGen finds plan inadequate — return to planning
IaC deployment failed — fix code and retry
Architect self-refinement loop (cost refresh, deep dive, SKU compare, save)
return_edges.ui_label_pattern: ^▶ (Refresh Cost Estimate|Deep Dive WAF Pillar|Compare SKU Options|Save Assessment)$

return_edges.reason: IaC Planner self-refinement loop (revise plan, compare AVM)

plan_lock.description: Once gate-3 (Plan Approval) is passed, 04-implementation-plan.md (including the new Governance Compliance Matrix and Code-Generation Contract H2 sections), 04-governance-constraints.md, and 04-governance-constraints.json (including its discovery_metadata L0 envelope) are read-only for step-5. 06-IaC CodeGen must traverse the return_edge to step-4 (Planner) for plan-level must_fix issues rather than self-editing the plan. Plan-level adversarial review (security-governance, architecture-reliability, cost-feasibility against the PLAN artifact) runs only at step-4; step-5 challenger passes use artifact_scope: iac-code. The four-layer governance attestation chain (L0 envelope → L1 plan matrix → L2 code attestation → L3 live precheck) is enforced end-to-end and audited via the `governance_trace` decision (`apex/decide`) before completing step 6.

attestation_chain.L1: Governance Compliance Matrix H2 in 04-implementation-plan.md (owner: 05-IaC Planner)
attestation_chain.L2: Per-row property attestation in iac-validate-subagent output (owner: 06-IaC CodeGen)

complexity_routing.description: Deterministic formula for selecting challenger-review pass counts. Orchestrator computes `score` at gate-1, stores result in session state `decisions.complexity`, and agents read from session state instead of re-deriving. Weights calibrated on existing agent-output projects; adjust via PR with rationale.

inputs.resource_count: Count of Azure resources declared in 02-architecture-assessment.md

decision_toggles.description: Project-scoped toggles set by 01-Orchestrator at session init. Each toggle has a default chosen to minimize latency/token cost; agents must honor session-state values when present. Read via `apex/status`; write via `apex/decide` with `key: <toggle>`, `value: <enum>`.

governance_depth.description: Controls policy-property-map and governance prose detail. Both modes MUST emit 04-policy-property-map.json covering every Deny policy; `light` omits non-Deny rationale prose only.

review_depth.description: `standard` runs single-pass comprehensive at mandatory gates. `deep` opts into multi-pass rotating lenses and enables Phase 4.5 challenger at step-5.

deployment_strategy.description: `single` is one `az deployment ... create` / `terraform apply`. `phased` splits into platform → workload → consumers with stop gates per `apex-iac-common/references/deploy-shared-workflow.md`.

identity_resolution.description: `auto` resolves UAMIs and app registrations from session decisions + manifest. `manual` requires user to fill 04-environment-manifest.json fields before deploy. See apex-azure-defaults/references/identity-resolution.md.

diagnostics_strategy.description: `avm` uses AVM's built-in diagnosticSettings parameter (lowest token cost). `module` emits a separate `modules/diagnostics.bicep|tf`. `auto` picks `avm` when the AVM module supports it, else falls back to `module`.

entra_app_creation.description: `existing` consumes pre-created app registrations from 04-environment-manifest.json (Graph blast radius zero). `create` requires Graph preflight (Application.ReadWrite.All) and lifecycle.prevent_destroy on the Terraform resource. See apex-terraform-patterns/references/azuread-pattern.md.
